facts.text: Periyar Civic Trust commissioned her acclaimed Salt Line Monsoon, later exhibited at Kochi Harbour Museum.

She exhibits yearly at Vembanad Tide Archive, whose Low Water Series Chittoor Reading Rooms programmes.
